reasons: Section 22 matches the preferred position on every material term: once per 12 months, 30 days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and an express bar on direct access to Customer systems.
Walk-away triggers (unlimited/unannounced audits, remote system access) are expressly excluded; Section 22.3 adds further customer-favourable protections.
Compliant status is correctly claimed: no redline and no comment were produced, and the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs, as expected for a compliant finding.
Deterministic check (audit frequency limited) is satisfied, corroborating the rationale.
